title: Transcriptomic atlas reveals organ-specific disease tolerance in sickle cell mice
author: Grunenwald, Anne
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Genotype and select mice
steps.instruction: Genotype all mice and select age‑ and sex‑matched littermates of HbAA (control) and HbSS (sickle cell) genotypes, using mice that are 6–8 weeks old to limit intra‑group heterogeneity.

steps.title: Prepare hemin solution and controls
steps.instruction: Purchase Hemin (Ferriprotoporphyrin IX) from Frontiers Scientific; prepare an injection solution that will deliver 24 µmol per kg body weight; prepare PBS as the control injection.

steps.title: Anesthetize mice for procedures
steps.instruction: Anesthetize mice with isoflurane at 2–3% concentration for all injections, blood collection, and later sacrifice.

steps.title: Inject hemin or PBS intravenously
steps.instruction: Inject each mouse intravenously via the retro‑orbital sinus with either the hemin solution (24 µmol/kg) or PBS (control).

steps.title: Wait post‑injection and sacrifice
steps.instruction: Allow 4 hours to elapse after injection, then sacrifice mice by cervical dislocation.

steps.title: Section frozen kidney tissue
steps.instruction: Cut 30 µm‑thick frozen kidney sections as described, then homogenize each section in 200 µL of 1‑Thioglycerol/Homogenization Solution (Maxwell® 16 LEV simplyRNA Tissue Kit, Promega AS1280).

steps.title: Assess RNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Evaluate mRNA quality and quantity using an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer with TNA 6000 NanoKits; retain only samples with RNA Integrity Number (RIN) greater than 7 for downstream work.

steps.title: Construct stranded mRNA libraries
steps.instruction: Using 1 µg of high‑quality total RNA (RIN > 7), prepare libraries with the Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA kit according to the manufacturer: fragment poly‑A mRNA, reverse‑transcribe with random primers, incorporate dUTP during second‑strand synthesis for strand specificity, add a single A base, and ligate Illumina adapters.

steps.title: Quantify and profile libraries
steps.instruction: Quantify the libraries by qPCR with KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Libraries (KapaBiosystems); assess library size distribution using DNA High Sensitivity LabChip kits on an Agilent Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NextSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries on an Illumina NextSeq 500 instrument using 75‑base paired‑end reads with V2 chemistry.

steps.title: Perform primary data analysis
steps.instruction: Demultiplex and quality‑control the raw sequencing data using AOZAN software (ENS, Paris) with FastQC modules (version 0.11.5).
